blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision Transformer architectures have showcased impressive performance on semantic segmentation, yet their quadratic attention complexity hinders practical applications. Recent works have focused on merging tokens to reduce sequence length and thus improve transformer efficiency. However, existing token merging methods primarily rely on feature similarity to identify similar tokens, overlooking spatial consistency, which may introduce segmentation errors in semantic segmentation. In this work, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that jointly considers feature similarity and spatial consistency in pairing similar tokens. The pairwise tokens are then merged within the encoder, and the resulting token sequences are reconstructed onto the original patch grid after decoding. The proposed method is flexible and can be plugged into existing vision Transformer-based semantic segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes show that SCMerge consistently achieves a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and efficiency than baseline methods.
blocks.zh: 视觉变形器架构在语义分解上展现出令人印象深刻的性能,然而其四相关注的复杂性阻碍了实际应用. 近期的作品以合并符为主来缩短序列长度并从而提高变压器的效率. 然而,现有的符号合并方法主要依靠特征相似性来识别相类似的符号,俯瞰空间一致性,这可能会引入语义分化中的分化错误. 在这项工作中,我们提议SCMorge,一种无培训的符号合并方法,它共同考虑在对等类似符号时的特征相似性和空间一致性. 配对符随后被合并到编码器内部,由此产生的符号序列在解码后被重建到原来的补丁网格上. 拟议的方法是灵活的,可以插入现有的以变形器为基础的语义分解管道. 对基准数据集ADE20K,Pascal Context,和Cityscapes的广泛实验表明,SCMorge在分解精度和效率之间始终比基准方法实现更好的取舍.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation has made significant progress with the recent introduction of Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 8 , 29 , 37 , 24 ] . However, ViTs with self-attention suffer from quadratic computational complexity and long latency, limiting their application to high-resolution images. A primary avenue for addressing this issue is to reduce token sequence length in self-attention and streamline computation [ 25 , 17 , 1 , 28 , 36 , 23 , 30 ] . Although most existing token reduction methods work well for image classification, they often struggle in dense prediction tasks, such as semantic segmentation. The main challenge is to reduce the token sequence length while preserving the spatial and semantic details required by the segmentation decoder.
blocks.zh: 语义分化随着"视觉变形器"(ViTs)最近推出[8,29,37,24]而取得了重大进展. 然而,自觉的ViTs则会受四极计算的复杂性和长时间的耐久性所影响,将其应用限制在高分辨率图像上. 解决这一问题的主要途径是减少自觉的符号序列长度并简化计算[25、17、1、28、36、23、30]。 虽然大多数现存的符号还原方法对于图像分类效果很好,但它们往往在密集的预测任务中挣扎,如语义分解. 主要的挑战是在保留分解码器所需的空间和语义细节的同时,减少符号序列长度.

blocks.en:
This work focuses on ViT-based semantic segmentation and aims to present a training-free token merging method to improve the efficiency of existing pipelines. Existing training-free token reduction methods have shown that merging similar tokens can effectively reduce the token sequence length and computational complexity. ToMe performs bipartite matching in feature space and merges similar tokens via averaging [ 1 ] .
Mutual Pair Merging (MPM) employs mutual nearest-neighbor matching and combines the matched tokens, yielding computation and latency improvements without modifying segmentation decoders [ 26 ] .
In addition, ALGM employs a segmentation-specific local-to-global merging schedule that combines local and global token matching [ 22 ] . Despite their potential, existing methods mainly match tokens based on feature similarity, which can cause segmentation errors when local feature content is similar but the tokens are spatially or globally different. Tokens near semantic boundaries may be incorrectly paired with interior tokens from neighboring regions, leading to boundary blurring. In addition, interior tokens from different objects can have similar features and be mistakenly identified as redundant. More recently, several works [ 19 , 13 ] have proposed to address this issue by introducing spatial information or learned policies, but at the cost of additional inputs or training.
blocks.zh:
这项工作侧重于基于ViT的语义分解,并旨在提出一种无培训符号合并方法来提高现有管线的效率. 现有的免训练的代号还原方法表明,合并类似的代号可以有效地降低代号序列长度和计算复杂性. ToMe在特性空间中执行双相匹配,并通过平均 [ 1] 合并相似的符号 。
相互对等合并(MPM)采用相邻相邻相接并结合相邻相接的符号,在不修改分码解码器的情况下产生计算和间隔改进[26].
此外,ALGM还采用分块化的本地到全球合并计划,将本地和全球性的符号结合到[22]. 尽管其潜力很大,但现有方法主要匹配基于地物相似性的地物符,当地地物符内容相似但地物符在空间上或全球上有所不同时,会出分块错误. 靠近语义边界的托肯可能与相邻地区的内饰相配不正确,导致边界模糊. 此外,来自不同物体的内饰可以具有相类似的特征并被错误地认定为冗余. 最近,有几项工作[19、13]提议通过采用空间信息或学习到的政策来解决这一问题,但以额外投入或培训为代价。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method to reduce the token length in ViT-based semantic segmentation pipelines, aiming to achieve a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational cost. To guide the merging process, We introduce a token-pairing criterion that jointly considers local feature similarity and spatial consistency.
By merging only tokens that are similar in both feature and spatial consistency, this mechanism improves the efficiency–accuracy trade-off. Specifically, we first compute the cosine similarity between all token pairs. A local variance measure is then used to identify tokens that are near semantic boundaries or lie in a smooth interior region. For each candidate pair, we compute a spatial-consistency penalty that discourages merging of locally similar but boundary-sensitive tokens, as well as tokens belonging to different objects. Finally, paired tokens are merged via feature averaging, and the reduced token sequence is passed through the segmentation decoder before being mapped back to the original token grid. This design refines the token pairing process to preserve semantic boundaries and neighborhood spatial consistency, improving segmentation efficiency.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出SCMorge,这是一种免费的符号合并方法,以减少以ViT为基础的语义分解管中的符号长度,目的是在分解精度和计算成本之间实现更好的取舍. 为了指导合并进程,我们采用了一种象征性的补偿标准,共同考虑局部特征的相似性和空间一致性。
这种机制只合并在特征和空间一致性上都相似的标志,从而提高了效率-准确性取舍。 具体来说,我们首先计算出所有符号对相的同心圆相似性. 然后使用局部差异度量法来识别接近语义边界或位于平滑内地的符号. 对于每一对候选者,我们计算出一个空间相容性处罚,以阻止合并当地类似但敏感地边界的标志,以及属于不同物体的标志. 最后,成对的活符通过地物平均法被合并,减少的活符序列在被映射回原活符网格之前会通过分块解码器传递. 这种设计完善了符号配对过程,以维护语义边界和相邻空间一致性,提高分化效率.

blocks.en: Our SCMerge does not require additional supervision, extra input modalities, or modifications to the segmentation head, allowing it to be plugged into ViT-based semantic segmentation pipelines. We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed token merging module using ViT-based segmentation models [ 29 ] on three semantic segmentation datasets, including ADE20K [ 38 ] , Pascal Context [ 21 ] , and Cityscapes [ 5 ] . Experimental results demonstrate that plugging our SCMerge module into ViT-based semantic segmentation models improves the trade-off between computational complexity and segmentation accuracy. Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose a novel training-free token-pair merging method that incorporates a spatial-consistency penalty into feature-similarity-based matching. This method prevents the merging of locally similar but spatially incompatible tokens and improving the accuracy–efficiency trade-off. • We design a local feature variation metric to identify boundary-sensitive tokens and introduce a spatial-consistency penalty, comprising a boundary-sensitive term and a neighborhood consistency term, to reduce incorrect merging near semantic boundaries and preserve fine spatial detail. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can be integrated into ViT-based semantic segmentation models to achieve a better accuracy‑efficiency trade‑off than baseline methods relying only on feature similarity.
blocks.zh: 我们的SCMorge不需要额外的监督,额外的输入方式,或者修改分块头,使其可以被插入以ViT为基础的语义分块管. 我们利用基于ViT的分解模型[29]在三个语义分解数据集上评价拟议符号合并模块的有效性,包括ADE20K [38],Pascal Context [21],和Cityscapes [5]. 实验结果表明,将我们的SCMorge模块插入基于ViT的语义分解模型可以改善计算复杂性和分解精度之间的取舍。 • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们提出一种新型的免费培训代币-佩尔合并方法,将空间一致性的罚则纳入基于地物-相似性的匹配中。 这种方法防止合并当地类似但空间不相容的标志并改进准确性-效率取舍。 我们设计了一个局部特征变异度量表,以识别出对边界敏感的符号,并引入一个空间相容性惩罚,包括一个对边界敏感的名词和邻里一致性名词,以减少不正确的近语义边界合并,并保存精细的空间细节. · 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法可以并入基于ViT的语义分解模型,以便比仅依靠特征相似性的基线方法实现更好的准确性-效率权衡。

blocks.en: We propose a novel training-free token-pair merging method that incorporates a spatial-consistency penalty into feature-similarity-based matching. This method prevents the merging of locally similar but spatially incompatible tokens and improving the accuracy–efficiency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种新型的免费培训代币-佩尔合并方法,将空间一致性的罚则纳入基于地物-相似性的匹配中。 这种方法防止了当地类似但空间不相容的标志的合并并改进准确性-效率取舍。

blocks.en: We design a local feature variation metric to identify boundary-sensitive tokens and introduce a spatial-consistency penalty, comprising a boundary-sensitive term and a neighborhood consistency term, to reduce incorrect merging near semantic boundaries and preserve fine spatial detail.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个局部特征变异度度量表,以识别对边界敏感的符号并引入空间相容性惩罚,其中包括对边界敏感的名词和邻里一致性名词,以减少不正确的近语义边界合并并保存细微的空间细节.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can be integrated into ViT-based semantic segmentation models to achieve a better accuracy‑efficiency trade‑off than baseline methods relying only on feature similarity.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法可以并入基于ViT的语义分解模型,以便比仅依靠特征相似性的基线方法实现更好的精度-效率权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Vision Transformer-based segmentation models, including SETR [ 37 ] , Segmenter [ 29 ] , DPT [ 24 ] , and Mask2Former [ 4 ] , have achieved promising performance in dense prediction tasks, but they suffer from high computational costs when processing high-resolution images. A possible solution is to redesign the architecture or attention mechanism.
SegFormer [ 34 ] adopts a hierarchical Transformer encoder with a lightweight all-MLP decoder.
Swin Transformer [ 18 ] restricts self-attention to shifted local windows, and PVT [ 32 ] progressively reduces spatial resolution to build pyramid features.
FlashAttention [ 6 ] accelerates attention by reducing memory input and output between GPU high-bandwidth memory and on-chip memory through tiled computation.
This work focuses on reducing redundant tokens inside a pretrained ViT encoder
, preserving the compact representation through decoding, and reconstructing the dense prediction grid
without changing the segmentation head.
blocks.zh:
基于Vision Transformer的分解模型,包括SETR [37],分解器 [29],DPT [24],和Mask2Former [4],在密集的预测任务中都取得了有希望的性能,但在处理高分辨率图像时却受到高昂的计算成本. 一个可能的解决办法是重新设计结构或关注机制。
SegFormer [34] 采用了带有轻量级全MLP解码器的分级变形器编码器.
Swin Transformer [18] 限制自觉转向本地窗口,而PVT [32] 逐渐降低空间分辨率来构建金字塔特征.
FlashAttention [6] 通过平面计算减少GPU高带宽内存和芯片内存之间的内存输入和输出来加速关注.
这项工作的重点是在经过预训的ViT编码器内减少冗余符号
通过解码来保留紧凑的表示,并重建密集的预测网格
没有改变分块头。

blocks.en:
Many recent methods accelerate ViTs by reducing the token sequences passed to subsequent layers.
DynamicViT [ 25 ] learns to prune uninformative tokens dynamically, while TokenLearner [ 28 ] learns a compact set of informative tokens.
A-ViT [ 36 ] introduces adaptive token halting, and IA-RED 2 [ 23 ] reduces redundancy with interpretability-aware token selection.
Patch Slimming [ 30 ] and SPViT [ 15 ] study efficient token pruning, while ATS [ 9 ] samples tokens adaptively.
Token Pooling [ 20 ] , STViT [ 12 ] , HeatViT [ 7 ] , and DiffRate [ 3 ] further explore pooling, sampling, pruning, or learnable compression rates.
These methods either target image classification or require learned policies, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications. Unlike classification tasks, preserving thin structures and fine boundaries is critical in dense prediction tasks. This depends on having a sufficient number of tokens for accurate reconstruction and precise predictions.
This work introduces a training-free token merging method designed for dense prediction.

这项工作采用了一种为密集预测而设计的无培训符号合并方法。

blocks.en:
Token merging has emerged as an effective technique for improving the efficiency of ViTs. By combining similar tokens rather than discarding them, token merging methods substantially reduce computational complexity and latency in image classification and semantic segmentation.
ToMe [ 1 ] is a training-free token merging method that matches feature-similar tokens and averages them progressively inside the encoder.
Several works have extended token merging with learned or adaptive mechanisms, including learned patch merging [ 27 ] , efficient token merging [ 10 ] , delayed spatial merging [ 11 ] , and learned pruning-and-merging thresholds [ 2 ] .
In addition, fusion-based or saliency-driven methods, such as token fusion [ 14 ] , multi-criteria fusion [ 16 ] , spectrum-preserving merging [ 31 ] , learnable token merging [ 33 ] , and saliency-driven merging [ 35 ] have been studied for token merging.
Mutual Pair Merging (MPM) [ 26 ] forms mutual nearest-neighbor token pairs and preserves a reconstruction map before the dense prediction decoder.
These methods can significantly improve ViT efficiency by averaging similar tokens, but their token grouping strategies mainly rely on feature similarity, which neglects spatial consistency when measuring token similarity. Our SCMerge addresses this limitation by using local feature variation to pair tokens in a more spatial-aware manner.
blocks.zh:
Token合并已成为提高ViTs效率的有效技术. 通过将相似的符号相合并而不是丢弃,符号相合并的方法会大大减少图像分类和语义分解中的计算复杂性和耐久性.
ToMe [1] 是一款无训练的符号合并方法,它与特征-类似符号相匹配并逐渐在编码器内进行平均.
一些作品扩展了与有知识或适应性机制的象征性合并,包括有知识的补丁合并[27],有效率的象征性合并[10],有延迟的空间合并[11],以及有知识的穿插-并合阈值[2].
此外,还研究了以聚变为主或以相干为主的方法,如以相干为主的聚变[14],以相干为主的多标准聚变[16],以相干为主的频谱保存合并[31],以相干为主的可学习的相干合并[33],以相干为主的相干合并[35]等.
相互对等合并(MPM) [26] 形成相距相近的相邻代币对并保留了密集预测解码器之前的重建图.
这些方法通过平均类似符号可以显著地提高ViT的效率,但其符号分组策略主要依赖于地物相似性,在测量符号相似性时忽略了空间一致性. 我们的SCMorge通过使用本地特性的变异以更能意识到空间的方式对配对符来解决这一限制.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of SCMerge. SCMerge is a plug-and-play module that can be inserted into multiple ViT encoder blocks to reduce the token sequence length while maintaining a merge map. It combines feature similarity with a spatial-consistency penalty to guide similar token pairing and merging. The reduced token sequence remains compact throughout decoding and is reconstructed onto the original dense prediction grid only after the decoder.
blocks.zh: 图1:SCMorge概况. SCMorge是一个插件和游戏模块,可以插入多个ViT编码器块来缩短符序长度,同时维持一个合并地图. 它将特征相似性与空间相容性惩罚结合起来,以引导类似的令牌对接和合并. 已减少的代号序列在整个解码过程中仍然紧凑,只有在解码器后才能被重建到最初的密集预测网格上.

blocks.en:
Several recent methods have incorporated task-specific or spatial information to improve token merging for semantic segmentation.
CTS [ 19 ] learns a content-aware token-sharing policy to preserve semantic structures.
ALGM [ 22 ] designs an adaptive local-to-global merging schedule for segmentation backbones.
ToSA [ 13 ] introduces spatial awareness into token merging so that merging decisions consider both visual feature similarity and spatial information.
These methods demonstrate the importance of spatial information for semantic segmentation, but they often rely on learned policies, specialized schedules, additional spatial information, or method-specific implementations.
SCMerge follows the same motivation of spatial-aware token merging, but it is training-free and can be plugged into existing ViT-based semantic segmentation pipelines.
blocks.zh:
最近的一些方法纳入了针对具体任务或空间信息,以改进语义分解的象征性合并。
CTS [19] 学习了内容感知符号共享政策,以保留语义结构.
ALGM [22] 为分化骨干设计了适应性局部到全球的合并时间表.
ToSA [13] 将空间意识引入象征性的合并,以便合并决定既考虑到视觉特征相似性,也考虑到空间信息。
这些方法表明了空间信息对于语义分解的重要性,但它们往往依赖于所学到的政策,专门的时间表,额外的空间信息,或特定方法的实施.
SCMorge跟随同样动机的空间-意识符号合并,但它是无训练的,可以被插入现有的以ViT为基础的语义分解管.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 1 , SCMerge is a training-free module that can be inserted into multiple blocks of a ViT encoder to reduce the token sequence length from N N to M M ( M < N M<N ),
while maintaining a merge map for reconstructing compact segmentation head outputs onto the original token grid after decoding.
Let X = [ x 1 , … , x N ] ∈ ℝ N × d X=[x_{1},\ldots,x_{N}]\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} denote the image tokens at a merge layer, where N N is the number of input tokens and d d is the feature dimension.
Each token x i x_{i} is indexed by a representative coordinate c i c_{i} for local neighborhood statistics, while a merge map tracks reconstruction assignments across merging stages. At each insertion, SCMerge first computes a feature-similarity matrix S S to measure content similarity between tokens. It then calculates local context variation within a 3 × 3 3\times 3 token neighborhood and uses this variation to assign a spatial-consistency penalty score when forming matching pairs. The matched token pairs are merged into a reduced sequence Y = [ y 1 , … , y M ] ∈ ℝ M × d Y=[y_{1},\ldots,y_{M}]\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} . The merged tokens are then propagated through the remaining backbone layers, while the corresponding merge map is stored.
The merged tokens are then fed into the decoder and segmentation head of the original ViT-based model to produce compact prediction logits. Finally, the merge map is used to reconstruct these compact logits onto the final semantic segmentation results.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: We follow existing semantic segmentation models [ 29 ] and use a standard Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder [ 8 ] and Mask Transformer decoder as our backbone. Given an input image of size H × W H\times W and patch size P P , the image is divided into N 0 = H / P × W / P N_{0}=H/P\times W/P non-overlapping patches. Each patch is linearly projected into a d d -dimensional embedding, which is added to a learned positional embedding, resulting in the initial token sequence X 0 ∈ ℝ N 0 × d X_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{0}\times d} . These tokens are then processed by a stack of Transformer blocks consisting of self-attention and feed-forward layers.

blocks.en:
The decoder then jointly processes the tokens from the encoder together with C C learnable class embeddings, where C C denotes the number of semantic classes.
After the Transformer decoder layers, the output image and class embeddings are projected and normalized, and the pairwise inner products between the image embeddings and the class embeddings produce patch-level class logits.
In the original full-token model, these logits correspond to the N 0 N_{0} patch locations and are reshaped into an H / P × W / P H/P\times W/P patch grid. They are then upsampled to the input resolution via bilinear interpolation.

在变形器解码器层后,输出图像和类嵌入被投影并规范化,图像嵌入和类嵌入之间的对等内出产出补丁级类日志.
在最初的全托接模式中,这些日志对应了N 0 N_{0}的补丁位置,被重塑为H / P × W / P H/P\times W/P补丁网格. 然后通过双线插图对输入分辨率进行取样。

blocks.en:
SCMerge Insertion. SCMerge is inserted after selected ViT encoder blocks and operates on the current token sequence. At each insertion, SCMerge reduces the token sequence length from N N to M M ( M < N M<N ).
To support multiple merge layers, SCMerge maintains a representative coordinate for each token and a merge map. The coordinate indicates the token’s position in the sparse token layout used for variation computation, while the merge map records, for each original patch location, the token that represents it. The merge map is updated after each merge stage. The reduced token sequence is then propagated through the remaining encoder blocks and passed through the Mask Transformer decoder. The decoder architecture and parameters remain unchanged, while only the number of input tokens is reduced. After decoding, the merge map restores the reduced logits to the original patch grid, followed by bilinear upsampling to the input resolution.
blocks.zh:
SCMerge 插入 。 SCMerge被插入到选定的ViT编码器块后,并运行在当前的符号序列上. 每次插入时,SCMerge会将符号序列长度从N到MM(M < N M < N.
为了支持多层合并,SCMorge为每个令牌维持一个代表性坐标和一个合并地图. 坐标表示符号在用于计算变量的稀有符号布局中的位置,而合并地图记录每个原始补丁位置,代表它的符号. 合并地图在每个合并阶段后都会被更新. 减少的代号序列再被通过剩下的编码器块来传播,并经过了"面具变形器"解码器. 解码器架构和参数保持不变,而只有输入符数被减少. 解码后,合并地图会将已减少的日志恢复到原来的补丁网格上,再由双线性上标到输入分辨率.

blocks.en: 3.3 Decoding and Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.3 解码和重建

blocks.en:
The reduced token sequence Y Y is passed through the segmentation decoder without spatial expansion, and the original token grid is reconstructed only after decoding for dense prediction. The segmentation decoder processes the merged token sequence Y Y and produces class logits H ∈ ℝ M × C H\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times C} , where C C is the number of semantic classes. The merge map maps each merged token’s logits back to the original patch locations, reconstructing the N 0 N_{0} patch logits. These logits are then reshaped into the original patch grid and bilinearly upsampled to the input resolution. For the Mask Transformer decoder, the M M reduced tokens are jointly processed with C C class embeddings, resulting in a sequence of M + C M+C tokens.
Thus, the token reduction is preserved across the entire encoder–decoder pipeline.
The decoder remains unchanged in architecture and parameters, introducing no extra learnable parameters.
blocks.zh:
已减少的代号序列Y Y通过分区解码器而无需空间扩展,而原代号网格只在为密集预测进行解码后再重建. 分块解码器处理合并的令牌序列Y并产生类对数H → R M → C H\in\ mathbb{R}^{M\times C},其中C为语义类数. 合并的地图地图将每个合并的符号的日志返回原补丁位置,重建了N 0 N_{0}补丁日志. 这些对数随后被重塑为原始的补丁网格并双线地被复制到输入分辨率. 对于"口罩变形器"解码器,MM减码符由C类嵌入器联合处理,形成M+C M+C等代币的序列.
因此,在整个编码器-解码器管道中都保留了象征性的减少。
解码器在结构和参数上保持不变,没有引入额外的可学习参数.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: This section evaluates the effectiveness and generalization of our method on semantic segmentation. We plug our token merging method into existing ViT-based semantic segmentation models and present quantitative and qualitative comparisons on three benchmark semantic segmentation datasets among full-token baseline models, models with feature-similarity-based token merging, and models with our method. Later, we also provide a comprehensive ablation study supporting our design choices.
blocks.zh: 本节评价我们语义分解方法的有效性和概括性. 我们把信使合并方法插入现有的基于ViT的语义分解模型中,并且提出对三个基准语义分解数据集的定量和定性比较,分别是:全托式基线模型,基于特征-相似性的相克合并模型,以及与我们的方法相克的相克模型. 稍后,我们还提供了一份综合论文,支持我们的设计选择。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets and Models. We conduct experiments on three datasets: ADE20K [ 38 ] , Pascal Context [ 21 ] , and Cityscapes [ 5 ] , which respectively cover scene parsing, object and stuff segmentation, and high-resolution street scenes.
Our experiments use Segmenter [ 29 ] as a baseline full-token model. To provide a fair comparison, we retain its released encoder and Mask Transformer decoder and keep the input resolution and validation protocol of each checkpoint unchanged. We insert the token merging operation after the second and fifth encoder blocks by default.
blocks.zh:
数据集与模型. 我们进行三个数据集的实验:ADE20K [38],Pascal Context [21],和Cityscapes [5],分别涵盖场景剖析,物体和东西分解,以及高分辨率街道场景.
我们的实验使用Secter[29]作为基线全托模型. 为了提供公平的比较,我们保留其已发布的编码器和面具变形器解码器,并保持每个检查站的输入分辨率和验证协议不变. 我们默认在第二和第五编码器块后插入符号合并操作 。

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We fix the deterministic channel-sketch width to d s = 48 d_{s}=48 across all datasets and backbones, using zero padding only when the feature dimension is not divisible by d s d_{s} .
After each merge stage, the remaining tokens are scattered onto a zero-filled sparse grid at their retained representative coordinates; only token features are averaged during merging.
We use zero-padded 3 × 3 3\times 3 average pooling with a fixed denominator to compute the first and second moments, and derive the variance as the centered second moment.
Assignment maps are combined across merge stages and used to reconstruct the dense logits after decoding the reduced tokens.

blocks.en: Baselines. We use the officially released Segmenter checkpoint as the full-token baseline model and as the backbone of all training-free token merging methods: ToMe [ 1 ] , MPM [ 26 ] , and SCMerge. For ToMe [ 1 ] , we use r = 200 r=200 for the 1024-token Segmenter-B/16 setting and scale r r proportionally with the initial token count for other resolutions and backbones, preserving the same per-layer reduction ratio. To compare our method with MPM under a similar token budget, we configure MPM to merge the top 76% of token pairs, and refer to this configuration as MPM-top.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 定量比较

blocks.en: Table 1 reports quantitative comparison results between the full-token baseline and token-merging methods in terms of mIoU, N final N_{\mathrm{final}} , GFLOPs, latency and accuracy-latency trade-off ratio R R . We observe that all training-free methods can be plugged into existing segmentation models and improve their accuracy-latency trade-off. MPM achieves the lowest latency but sacrifices more segmentation accuracy than other token merging methods. Under a matched token budget, MPM-top achieves better segmentation accuracy than the original MPM but leads to higher latency. Our SCMerge, with spatial-consistency-aware token merging, achieves the best accuracy-latency trade-off among all training-free token merging methods. Specifically, on ADE20K, our SCMerge consistently achieves the highest mIoU and the highest R R among the training-free methods, showing that its accuracy–latency advantage is maintained as token density and backbone capacity increase. The same trend transfers to Pascal Context and Cityscapes. Although MPM generally achieves lower raw latency, SCMerge consistently preserves higher segmentation accuracy and yields a higher R R , indicating a more favorable accuracy–latency trade-off. Across all six model–dataset settings, SCMerge improves over MPM by 0.18 0.18 – 0.76 0.76 mIoU while reducing full-token latency by approximately 26 % 26\% – 36 % 36\% , without retraining or dataset-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表1从mIoU、N QQMTHRM{ Final }}、GFLOPs、即时性和准确性-相对比 R 等角度,报告完整基准和象征性合并方法之间的定量比较结果。 我们观察到,所有无训练方法都可以被插入现有的分解模型并改进它们的精确度-相关性取舍. MPM实现最低的耐久性,但比起其他符号合并方法,牺牲了更多的分解精度. 在相匹配的代号预算下,MPM-top比最初的MPM更能实现分解精度,但会导致更长时间. 我们的SCMorge,在空间一致性-意识符号合并的情况下,在所有无培训符号合并方法中实现最佳的精确度-相关性取舍。 具体地说,在ADE20K上,我们的SCMorge在无训练方法中始终实现了最高的mIoU和最高的RR,表明其精确度-相对性优势随着象征密度和骨干容量的提高而得到保持. 同样的趋势转移到了帕斯卡尔背景和城市景观. 虽然MPM一般实现更低的生活性,但SCMorge始终保持更高的分解精度并产生更高的R R ,表明更有利的精度-相对取舍. 在所有六个模型 — — 数据集设置中,SCMorge比 MPM 改进了0.18 0.18 — — 0.76 0.76 mIoU,同时将全音位空闲率降低约 26 % 26 — — 36% 36 — — 而不进行再培训和数据集特有的微调。

blocks.en: In Figure 2 , we visualize the token assignment maps that indicate the source patches for each merged token, along with the spatial-consistency penalty values of the selected pairs. Our SCMerge achieves the lowest average values of both B i ​ j B_{ij} and D i ​ j D_{ij} across all compared methods. This result is consistent with the intended effect of the spatial-consistency penalty, which prioritizes pairs with low boundary sensitivity and small neighborhood inconsistency. The corresponding visualization shows that the proposed criterion encourages more spatially consistent token merging.
blocks.zh: 在图2中,我们可视化显示每个合并的令牌的源补丁的令牌分配图,以及所选对子的空间相容度值. 我们的SCMerge在所有比较方法中都实现了B i j B_{ij 和 D j D_{ij 的最低平均值. 这一结果与空间相容性处罚的预期效果是一致的,即优先处理边界敏感度低和相邻性小的对等. 相应的可视化显示,拟议标准鼓励在空间上更加一致地将信使合并.

blocks.en: Figure 3 provides a visual comparison of the resulting segmentation predictions and the corresponding pixel-wise error maps. The visualization results show that our SCMerge achieves higher segmentation accuracy and a fewer pixel-wise error rate that baseline token-merging methods: ToMe, MPM, and MPM-top, with an error rate of 7.96 % 7.96\% compared to 9.52 % 9.52\% , 9.66 % 9.66\% , and 8.50 % 8.50\% , respectively. This is consistent with the quantitative comparison results, demonstrating that spatial-consistency-aware token pairing is effective in preserving segmentation quality after token reduction.
blocks.zh: 图3对由此产生的分解预测和相应的像素偏移误差图进行了可视化比较. 可视化结果显示,我们的SCMorge实现了更高的分化精度,并降低了以像素为单位的误差率,这些基准符-符号-并列方法: ToMe, MPM,和 MPM-top的误差率为7.96% 7.96%,而9.52%,9.66% 9.66%,8.50% 8.50%。 这与定量比较结果一致,表明空间一致性-知能相配能有效地在减价后保持分化质量。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.4 违约

blocks.en: Table 2 provides the effectiveness of spatial-consistency-aware token pairing and post-decoder reconstruction. We compare our full design with three variants: 1) without both spatial-consistency penalty R i ​ j R_{ij} and post-decoder reconstruction, i.e., reconstructing the original token grid before the decoder ( w/o penalty and Post-decoder ); 2) without spatial-consistency penalty R i ​ j R_{ij} ( w/o penalty ); and 3) without post-decoder reconstruction ( w/o Post-decoder ). We observe that the spatial-consistency penalty improves segmentation accuracy while slightly increasing latency, whereas post-decoder reconstruction significantly reduces latency but slightly reduces accuracy. Our full design with both spatial-consistency penalty and post-decoder reconstruction achieves a better overall accuracy-latency trade-off.

blocks.en: Figure 4 analyzes the effect of insertion depth on the accuracy–efficiency trade-off. Applying token merging at earlier encoder stages yields greater computational savings in subsequent layers but makes token matching more susceptible to incorrect pairing. In contrast, merging at later stages preserves finer spatial structures and segmentation accuracy at the cost of reduced latency gains. Therefore, token merging is performed in the early-to-middle encoder blocks.
blocks.zh: 图4分析了插入深度对准确性-效率取舍的影响。 在较早的编码器阶段应用符号合并,在随后的分层中会产生更大的计算节约,但使符号匹配更容易被错误地配对. 相形之下,在后期的合并可以保持更细的空间结构和分解精度,而代价是延时增益减少. 因此,符号合并是在早期到中编码器块中进行.

blocks.en: Boundary Preservation. Table 3 reports B-mIoU@5 (mIoU within 5 pixels of boundaries) and B-Merge (fraction of boundary tokens involved in merges). Our SCMerge improves B-mIoU@5 while sharply reducing B-Merge, confirming that the boundary-sensitivity term B i ​ j B_{ij} prevents boundary tokens from being merged, improving boundary segmentation quality.
blocks.zh: 边界保护。 表3报告了B-mIoU@5(5像素范围内的mIoU)和B-Morge(合并涉及的边界标志被破坏). 我们的SCMorge改进了B-mIoU@5,同时大幅度地缩小了B-Morge,证实了边界敏感度术语B i j B_{ij}阻止了边界标志被合并,提高了边界分解的质量.

blocks.en: Neighborhood Consistency. Table 4 reports the neighborhood consistency of selected token pairs. Cross-cls denotes the fraction of pairs connecting tokens from different classes, while N-Agree measures the position-wise label agreement between the 3 × 3 3\times 3 neighborhoods of paired tokens. Our SCMerge produces significantly fewer cross-class pairs and achieves higher N-Agree, indicating that D i ​ j D_{ij} effectively promotes the selection of semantically consistent token pairs.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that conducts token merging based on both feature similarity and spatial consistency for semantic segmentation. The method is flexible and can be plugged into existing ViT-based semantic segmentation models for improving computation efficiency with less quality drop. Extensive comparison experiments on three benchmark semantic segmentation datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes demonstrate that our SCMerge can achieve better accuracy-latency trade-off compared with existing state-of-the-art training-free token merging methods. Although our SCMerge with the spatial-consistency penalty mitigates boundary blurring, very small objects and extremely thin structures may still be smoothed due to information aggregation. In addition, since SCMerge is training-free and introduces no learnable parameters, its merging decisions are based on fixed, hand-designed criteria. This may limit its adaptability to diverse or unseen visual patterns. Addressing these limitations is a direction for our future work while preserving the plug-and-play and training-free advantages of SCMerge.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了SCMorge,这是一种免费的符号合并方法,根据语义分解的特征相似性和空间一致性进行符号合并。 这种方法是灵活的,可以插入现有的基于ViT的语义分解模型来用更低的质量下降来提高计算效率. 三个基准语义分解数据集ADE20K,Pascal Context,和Cityscapes的广泛比较实验表明,与现有的最先进的无培训符号合并方法相比,我们的SCMerge可以实现更好的精度相对应. 虽然我们的SCMelge在空间相容性能上减轻了边界模糊,但由于信息聚合,极小的物体和极薄的结构仍然可能平滑. 此外,由于SCMorge是无培训的,没有引入可学习的参数,其合并决定基于固定的,手工设计出的标准. 这可能会限制其适应性,使其局限于多样或看不见的视觉模式. 解决这些局限性是我们未来工作的方向,同时保持SCMerge的插头和游戏以及无训练优势.
